visual.general_description: Eight-panel composite of six axial chest CT slices (A to F) and two clinical skin photographs (G, H).
visual.detailed_description: Top row panels A to D and bottom row panels E and F are grayscale axial chest CT slices in a lung window, each with its letter at upper left and small unreadable orange overlay text. Panel A shows largely clear lungs, panel B extensive bilateral perihilar hazy and reticular opacities, panel C persisting but reduced opacities, panel D fewer residual opacities, and panels E and F largely clear lungs. Panels G and H are color photographs: G shows multiple dark purple-red skin patches beside a gauze dressing with a clear tube, and H shows an arm with extensive purple, red and yellow-brown discoloration.

The chest wall, mediastinum with great vessels and the airway are visible, and tubing lines lie above the chest. Small orange overlay text in the top right corner and lower left corner of the slice is too small to read.

visual.general_description: Line chart of serum creatinine and PR3 with treatment annotation boxes.
visual.detailed_description: Two lines over a categorical date axis that begins with sparse 2021 to 2023 dates and then becomes dense from 2024/2/14 to 2024/9/29. The blue line (SCr) sits near 130 before February 2024, rises to roughly 650 around the first treatment boxes, fluctuates between about 150 and 870 through March to May and settles near 130 at the end. The red line (PR3) starts at a printed 2350, stays near 2100 to 2165 and then falls steeply through printed labels 1985, 657.8, 320.48 and 230.4 around late March, rebounds to 1343.4, dips to 1029.9, rises again through 1208.9 to 1276.1, then falls through 1021.9 and 830.3 to 673, rises slightly to 708.8 and declines through 657.8, 535, 447.4 and 282.8 to a final 150. Black text boxes with arrows label the methylprednisolone with cyclophosphamide, plasma exchanges, rituximab doses, methylprednisolone tablet taper, a red box for the small-dose long-course rituximab, a capsule entry and belimumab. A legend at upper right names SCr in blue and PR3 in red.
